correction:
This phase is critical.

The learning system is useless unless newly learned behavior affects future agent behavior automatically.

Create a dedicated workspace Skill:

.agents/skills/academic-adaptive-context/SKILL.md

This is NOT an orchestration Skill.

Its purpose is to provide the active learned behavioral context relevant to the current task.

The Skill must instruct the agent to:

Determine the current capability.
Retrieve relevant active lessons.
Retrieve relevant anti-patterns.
Retrieve relevant exemplars.
Check for known failure modes.
Apply only knowledge relevant to the current task.
Respect applicability/exclusion conditions.
Avoid treating one-off project preferences as universal rules.

Do not dump the entire learning repository into the prompt.

Use targeted retrieval.

The Skill should read from the persistent learning store and provide only relevant context.

Integrate this Skill with the durable AcademicSuite agents and the relevant specialist agents.

Do not make the Skill responsible for orchestration.

Do not make it execute statistical analyses.

Do not make it rewrite itself.

The objective is:

NEXT TASK
→ relevant learned behavior automatically available.

Acceptance criteria:

A lesson promoted during Project A can influence a later task in Project A.

A relevant learned behavior is retrieved automatically without the user explicitly requesting it.

Irrelevant lessons are not blindly injected.

The Skill remains small and acts as a context/retrieval mechanism rather than a giant knowledge dump.
